title: Geometrically reduced group schemes are smooth
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $G$ be a group scheme over $k$ [def-sc-group-scheme], locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Suppose $G$ is geometrically reduced [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], meaning that $G\times_k L$ is reduced for every field extension $L/k$. Then $G\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms].
